sources.verified: Yes (2026-10-12): pulled 2 slices of Diast/1 by HTTP range: Modality CT, SIEMENS SOMATOM Force, StudyDescription 'Cardiac^CCT_Retro_FC (Adult)', SeriesDescription 'ibhc 0.75 Bv36 3 BestDiast -180 ms', ContrastBolusAgent Iopamiro, 110 kVp, 0.75 mm slices, 0.26 mm pixels, slice p99.5 = 474-483 HU (enhanced blood pool + bone). sources.notes: Best T1 find of this sweep: 40 genuinely new ECG-gated retrospective CCTA patients, high resolution, permissive licence. Patients were selected as 'normal' perfusion, so mostly non-obstructive coronaries. Systolic and diastolic phases are the same patients (count 40 scans for annotation, 80 volumes).
